purpose: Copy-engine transport/duplex sanity check, not a performance result
selection: Only memcpy records whose (deviceId, streamId) has a dmaSignal kernel; excludes NCCL, caller buffers and the other backends
reference_operations: one warmup and one timed invocation each of AG and RS
caveat: Intersection counts are instrumentation-sensitive, not bandwidth, speedup or a model-level overlap measurement. Large binary traces remain in ignored build storage.
